description_en: Retrieves the details of a host group
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost get-host-group --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --host-group-id 1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetHostGroup

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the bastion host whose asset group you want to query.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to query the bastion host ID
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询的资产组所在的堡垒机的实例ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host whose asset group you want to query.

For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询的资产组所在堡垒机的区域ID。
区域ID和区域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the asset group to query.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/204509.html operation to query the asset group ID
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询的资产组ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/201307.html接口获取该参数
